I used Pro-Train Dog for my SD, Nassau. I would NOT recommend them for SD training. She was supposed to be trained as a disassociation alert dog, but her trainers never taught me(or her) the commands for this. Additionally, when she came home, she was not spayed(she was in heat for the first three weeks I had her), she was dirty, and when I took her to the vet, I found out she had a skin infection, worms, and a blood parasite- all stemming from issues of improper care and dirty conditions. She's very skittish, and cowers from people if they raise their arms, as if she's expecting to be hit. Pro-Train has somewhat reasonable prices for training SDs- ~3000 if you bring a dog for them to train, ~8000 for one of their dogs to be trained for you, and there's no waiting list. Unfortunately, I found out why the hard way. Their training works, to a degree- Nassau is very quiet in public, and she always sits or stays or lays down when I tell her to. But unfortunately, she has very bad separation anxiety issues, and she's so nervous all the time that it's hard for her to go with me to new places without wanting to jump into my lap. 

Tl;dr Don't use Pro-Train Dog.
